## Stegaloviper (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
N Huge magical beast  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 6, flat-footed 20 (-2 Dex, +14  natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 126 (9d10+36)  
**Fort** +12, **Ref** +4, **Will** +5; **DR** 10/adamantine or bludgeoning  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +16 (2d8+8 plus poison), tail slap +10 (2d10+4 plus trip)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (tail 25 ft.)  
**Special Attacks** poison  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** A stegaloviper climbs up above or burrows underneath its opponents.  

 **During Combat** Stegalovipers prefer to use their tails in combat, but when an enemy survives more than one hit it uses both its natural attacks on one target at a time.  

 **Morale** A stegaloviper retreats when reduced to 8 hp or less.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 7, **Con** 19, Int 8, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 27 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Stealth), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +2, Perception +9, Stealth +0; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth when in subterranean or rocky terrain  

**Special Abilities**

 **Stegaloviper Poison (Ex)** **Bite—injury**; save—Fort DC 18; onset—immediate; frequency—1/round for 10 rounds; effect—1d6 Constitution; cure—2 consecutive saves.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any subterranean  
**Organization** solitary, pair or nest (4–9)  
**Treasure** incidental
